title: THE NIGHT SCHOOL FOR MONSTERS
deck: At midnight an eclipse will magnify the involuntary powers of thirty-two young people confined behind the walls of Northwall School. The injured town waits outside with suppression weapons; the students are preparing to break out. Illuminara must prove that freedom can be practiced without asking survivors to gamble their bodies or children to disappear for everyone else's peace.
shape: Seven scenes through one eclipse night: two armed lines at Northwall's gate; the silence by which the school hides fear until power erupts; a survivor's strongest refusal; a voluntary practice whose first failure breaks the observatory and proves the old method unsafe; students and townspeople redesigning the test with separate vetoes; a total-eclipse drill in which Illuminara holds the structure while the young people regulate themselves; and a freely signed graduated-freedom charter with restitution, independent oversight and the first gate opened by choice.

scenes.title: Two Lines at the Gate
paragraphs: *Northwall School, upper gate above the town of Vela · 18:14, five hours forty-six minutes before total eclipse*
The students had painted MONSTERS on the inside of the iron gate before the townspeople arrived with suppression rifles. The word was backward from the road. From the schoolyard, it read correctly.

Thirty-two young people stood behind the bars in grey practice clothes. Across the road, three hundred townspeople held lamps, shields and the long white weapons that turned dangerous gifts briefly numb. Some had brought food. Some had brought stones.
Illuminara landed between the two lines without a flash. Dust rose around her boots and settled.

Headmaster Vale came down the school steps with a copper control band around one wrist. He was tall, silver-haired and careful with the left side of his body. The first uncontrolled surge had broken his hip and killed neither his fear nor his sense of duty.

Behind the town shields stood Mara Tern, the mechanic who had pulled six children from the market fire three years earlier. The skin of her right hand was smooth and pale. Its last three fingers no longer closed.
A girl at the gate looped one hand through the bars. Fine blue sparks followed her pulse. Suri Dane was seventeen and had been confined since the market fire.

**Suri**  
If they fire first, we go through the east wall.

**Vale**  
If you go through any wall during eclipse amplification, people below it die.

**Suri**  
Then open the gate before midnight.

**Vale**  
I will not trade the town's safety for a promise no instrument can verify.

A boy beside Suri kept both palms pressed to his thighs. Each time someone in the crowd shouted, the gravel around his shoes lifted a finger's breadth and fell. His name was Oren Ilyas. Fear changed gravity near him; shame made the change arrive without warning.

**Mara Tern**  
Nobody opens anything tonight.
Suri's sparks brightened.

**Mara Tern**  
You want my strongest answer? Here it is. The last time the school said controlled, I woke under a market awning with my hand cooking inside my glove. There was no eclipse. There was no armed crowd. You had instructors and walls. Your proof failed before you began.
Illuminara faced her, not the rifles.

**Illuminara**  
Then no one will ask you to trust the word controlled. What would count as evidence, and what risk will you refuse even if the students remain imprisoned?
Mara studied her as if expecting the question to hide a command.

**Mara Tern**  
No practice outside the walls. No test that cannot be stopped by the people inside it and the people below it. No calling a broken window success because nobody died.

**Vale**  
No chamber has reproduced totality. Every model becomes a guess at midnight.

**Suri**  
And his answer to uncertainty is forever.
The moon had already taken a dark bite from the sun on the western horizon. The school's copper dampening towers began to hum.
Illuminara looked at Vale's band, Mara's hand and Oren's rigid palms.

**Illuminara**  
I will not open the gate for you, and I will not help anyone keep it closed forever. Give me one hour to learn what this school calls control. After that, each side may still say no.
Suri released the bars.

**Suri**  
One hour. You listen where they tell us not to speak.

scenes.title: The Lesson Called Calm
paragraphs: *Northwall School, regulation hall · 18:42, five hours eighteen minutes before total eclipse*
Thirty-two white circles covered the floor. Above each, a monitor displayed one word: CALM.
Vale placed Suri and Oren in separate circles. Copper filaments drank the edge from Suri's sparks; Oren's gravel settled. Both monitors shone green.

**Vale**  
The field reduces expression until a student returns to baseline. Stillness comes before supervised movement.

**Suri**  
We rehearse looking harmless.

**Vale**  
Looking harmless has kept the town from attacking for three years.
He rang the bell.

**Vale**  
State neutral.

**Suri**  
Neutral.
Her jaw locked. Blue light gathered under the skin of her throat; the monitor stayed green.

**Vale**  
Oren. State neutral.

**Oren**  
Neutral.
A metal stool beside him sank into the floor without bending.
Illuminara touched neither student. She crossed to the copper seam behind Suri and held her palm a finger's breadth from it.

**Illuminara**  
Headmaster, stand here. Keep one eye on her monitor and one on this seam.

**Vale**  
For what purpose?

**Illuminara**  
To see whether green means nothing is happening, or only that nothing is leaving her.
She asked Vale to lower the field by three percent. He refused. She asked Suri whether she would continue under the same setting. Suri refused too.
For several seconds the room held two valid noes and no procedure between them.

**Suri**  
I will say one true thing if his hand stays off the band for ten seconds.
Vale removed his hand. Suri watched it fall to his side.

**Suri**  
I am frightened.
The monitor remained green. One breath later, the seam beneath Illuminara's palm warmed. On the second, it glowed orange.

**Vale**  
The field is carrying her rise into the wall.
Oren lifted his head.

**Oren**  
My fingers go cold first. Twenty seconds before the gravel, maybe. Pell called it anticipatory dramatization.

**Suri**  
My hearing narrows. If I name it, they increase suppression. Then the light has nowhere small to go.
The orange line lengthened although Suri's display still read CALM. Vale looked from the seam to the stool embedded in the floor.

**Vale**  
The instruments record what escapes after the field has hidden the warning. We may have counted postponed signals as prevention.
The seam cracked. Vale shut the hall down. Suri's blue light struck the darkened copper and vanished; Oren's stool jumped back to its height.
No one was hurt. CALM went black above every circle.

**Vale**  
If this is true, the method I used to protect them taught me not to hear them.

**Illuminara**  
We have one observation, not a verdict. Test it—but do not make them pay forever to spare you the test.

scenes.title: What the Injured Are Owed
paragraphs: *Northwall School, visitors' infirmary · 19:27, four hours thirty-three minutes before total eclipse*
Mara entered the school with her rifle unloaded and carried by someone else. She had agreed to observe, not forgive.
Suri waited beside an examination table. The last time they had been this close, Suri was fourteen, unconscious and burning so brightly that the market roof had turned transparent before it fell.
Neither offered an apology first.

**Mara Tern**  
Do you remember me?

**Suri**  
I remember your red coat. I remember thinking it was on fire. I remember waking here and being told three people had burns because I panicked.
Mara placed her right hand on the table. The three damaged fingers stayed open.

**Mara Tern**  
Thirty-one people had burns. Three stayed in hospital. My workshop closed for eight months. The school paid for skin treatment and called the rest civic loss.
Suri swallowed. Blue sparks appeared in the wet corners of her eyes.
Vale touched his control band.

**Suri**  
Don't.

**Vale**  
Your output is rising.

**Suri**  
My hearing is narrowing. Mara's voice still has a middle. I am afraid she wants me locked here until I die. I am not going to burn her for saying so.

The sparks ran down Suri's arms and stopped at her fingertips. The room lights flickered. She breathed once, looked at Mara and chose the empty steel basin beside the table. A thin blue ribbon crossed the air and melted a coin-sized pool in its bottom.
Vale's band registered a release below the old incident threshold.
Mara did not move her hand.

**Mara Tern**  
That is the first time anyone here showed me the part before the fire.

**Suri**  
It is the first time they let me say it while it was small.
Mara turned to Illuminara.

**Mara Tern**  
Small in this room is not small under totality.

**Illuminara**  
No. The amplification remains unknown. What Suri proved is narrower: naming a warning can create time for a chosen release. The final test must prove whether the time survives the eclipse.

**Mara Tern**  
And if it does?

**Suri**  
Then I get to leave?

**Mara Tern**  
Then you owe people more than being less dangerous.
Suri looked at the damaged hand.

**Suri**  
I owe repair, not a promise to be less dangerous. Use the school endowment for a restitution trust; injured people choose the repairs and never have to meet us.

**Mara Tern**  
My workshop lost its contracts because I could no longer close a wrench. Put paid work and adaptive tools in the trust before anyone calls this reconciliation.
Illuminara wrote both terms on the infirmary wall display. No forgiveness was entered beside them.

scenes.title: The First Honest Failure
paragraphs: *Northwall School, old observatory · 21:06, two hours fifty-four minutes before total eclipse*

The observatory had no wall facing the town. Its open arch looked instead toward an abandoned quarry cut into the mountain. Vale approved it because any released force could travel into empty stone. Mara approved it because the practice remained inside the school boundary.

Suri and Oren entered by choice. Either could leave through a door without a lock. Mara held the outside abort switch. Vale held the school field control. Suri held a red cord that would cut power to her own circle. Oren held another.

Illuminara stood between the circles and the observatory's load-bearing arch. She could hold the stone if it broke. She could not take the students' powers from them, nor would she decide when their fear became unacceptable.
The partial eclipse deepened. Suri's blue light doubled at the same emotional signal. Oren's field pulled dust into a floating ring.

**Suri**  
My hearing is narrowing. Oren sounds far away. I want the east basin.

**Oren**  
Fingers cold. Fifteen seconds. I want the quarry floor.
Vale hesitated over his control.

**Vale**  
Outputs exceed the hall limit.

**Suri**  
That limit was built for silence.
Mara kept her hand above the abort switch.

**Mara Tern**  
Continue one step. My call.

Suri directed a thin arc into the east basin. Oren lowered the gravity of the quarry floor by a fraction, letting the arc spread over rising dust instead of striking stone. For three seconds the blue light became a quiet sheet suspended outside the arch.
Illuminara felt delight arrive before caution could name it. The two young people had made a small artificial dawn from the very signals the school had forbidden. She laughed once, and Suri heard it.

**Suri**  
Was that in the procedure?

**Illuminara**  
No. Keep it if it helps.
Then Oren looked toward the gate. The crowd had begun chanting. His fingers went white.

**Oren**  
Five seconds. Too fast.
The floating dust collapsed into a dense black knot. Suri's light bent toward it instead of the basin.

**Vale**  
Abort.
Vale increased the suppression field. The sudden pressure erased Oren's remaining warning and drove Suri's arc sideways. She pulled her red cord, but the field had already fused its contact.
Mara struck the outside abort. The arch power died. The stone above Illuminara split.

She took its weight on both hands while Oren's gravity knot dragged broken instruments across the floor. Suri threw herself beside him, not to restrain him, but to put her voice inside the narrowing world.

**Suri**  
Oren. My voice has a middle. Your left hand is warm. Quarry floor, not the crowd.

**Oren**  
I can't find down.

**Suri**  
Use me. I am standing. Down is where my feet are.
Oren looked at her boots. The black knot opened. Instruments fell. Suri sent the remaining light into the empty quarry, where it scored a blue line across thirty metres of rock.
The observatory arch came down slowly in Illuminara's hands. She held it until everyone crossed the threshold, then set the broken stone into the yard.
The test had failed. One monitoring rig was destroyed, the observatory roof was gone and Oren's right wrist was bruised where gravity had folded his control band against him.
Mara examined the fused red switch.

**Mara Tern**  
Suppression turned the warning into the accident.
Vale removed his copper band.

**Vale**  
My intervention did.

**Suri**  
Then don't ask us to trust your hand at midnight.
Vale looked at the broken observatory and did not defend himself.

**Vale**  
I won't. Design a system in which my fear is a warning, not an order.

scenes.title: A Test Everyone Could Stop
paragraphs: *Northwall School, assembly workshop · 22:02, one hour fifty-eight minutes before total eclipse*
They redesigned the final drill around the failure, not around anyone's dignity.
Oren drew three zones: the student named the warning and chose the release; a partner repeated only what could be observed; outside observers could stop progression but could not trigger suppression.

Suri rebuilt the fused cord as a mechanical shutter. Mara tested its handle with her damaged hand. Vale opened a spillway that would drop loose basalt into an empty channel whenever heat or gravity crossed the limit.
Illuminara looked from Mara's abort switch to the students' red cords.

**Illuminara**  
If the person inside is too frightened to name stop, who may call it? And may that hand restart suppression?

**Mara Tern**  
Outside observers may stop progression. Nobody outside may start suppression.

**Suri**  
And stopping tonight does not cancel our right to a corrected test.

**Vale**  
At totality the warning window may disappear. Then we learn nothing except that I was right to keep the gate shut.

**Oren**  
Then we stop. Tomorrow you are still wrong about forever.
Vale took the answer without defending the three lost years.

Success would open only a thirty-day trial: daylight exits, student-chosen escorts, monitors chosen by injured residents and restrictions proved person by person. Failure preserved the right to a corrected test.

**Mara Tern**  
Dangerous is not a surname. Neither is injured. The trust pays repairs first, and nobody buys forgiveness with it.

**Vale**  
Anyone may stay for training without surrendering the right to leave later.

**Illuminara**  
Take it to the people who can still refuse it.
At the lower gate, Mara laid the school's suppressed-warning records on the stone barrier. Tomas Ren, whose daughter had spent eleven weeks in the burn ward, read the first one.

**Tomas Ren**  
The school hid these warnings and our council paid for the guns. Now the same school asks my daughter to stand below its experiment.

**Mara Tern**  
She stands wherever she chooses. I hold the stop lever, injured residents choose the monitors, and the gun contract funds the first restitution claims.
Tomas read the next warning.

**Tomas Ren**  
One drill. Rifles down, not gone. I am watching the lever, not trusting the school.
Upstairs, Suri read the same four lines to the dormitories. Twenty-eight students signed. Lio Venn, whose skin became glass under stress, kept his name off the page.

**Lio Venn**  
If I join, they will call my body proof whether I consent or not.

**Suri**  
Then do not join. Will you stay behind the inner wall until the drill ends?

**Lio Venn**  
If my refusal stays on the plan.
Suri wrote it in ink. Three others added their refusals beneath his.
Mara returned with the town's bounded assent; Suri returned with twenty-eight signatures and four named noes. Vale read every line.

**Vale**  
Proceed.

scenes.title: Totality
paragraphs: *Northwall School, quarry practice ground · 23:56, four minutes before total eclipse*
The moon erased the sun's last white edge. Vela's lamps came on in the daytime dark.
Six students stood in the inner zone. Vale wore no control band. Mara held the outer shutter; the crowd waited behind the lower barrier. Illuminara stood beneath the repaired frame, hands free.
At totality Suri's blue light rose around her knees. Oren's gravity lifted a ring of pebbles. The field output climbed nearly three times as fast as it had in the observatory.

**Suri**  
My hearing is narrowing. I am afraid of the crowd and more afraid of going back upstairs. East basin.

**Oren**  
Left hand warm. Quarry floor.

Light spread across the pebbles and made each one a blue star. The load frame shifted. Illuminara caught only the force that would have thrown metal toward the observers; the students' fields remained their own.
A man at the barrier raised a suppression rifle.

**Tomas Ren**  
The blue line is crossing the mark!

**Mara Tern**  
It is inside the basin. Put it down.
He fired. The white pulse struck the barrier, not the students, but Oren saw it. His warning window collapsed.

**Oren**  
All cold.
Mara reached for the shutter. Vale did too, then stopped.

**Vale**  
Oren, I am afraid. I am not ordering calm. What do you observe?
The pebbles accelerated. Suri's voice came steadily through the dark.

**Suri**  
My feet are down. Illuminara is holding the frame. Mara has not closed the shutter. The rifle is on the ground.
Tomas stepped away from it, both hands visible.

**Tomas Ren**  
My daughter was under the market glass. I thought the line was coming for us.

**Mara Tern**  
Your fear explains the shot. It does not excuse it. Step back.
He obeyed. Mara kept the lever open.

**Mara Tern**  
Your call, Oren. Stop or one step.

**Oren**  
One step. Open the floor.

Vale released the spillway. Oren drew the falling basalt into a black sphere the size of a fist, then dropped it into the empty quarry. The mountain rang. Suri sent her light down the channel after it.
The frame stopped moving. Illuminara released it; the repaired braces held.
Three more students entered in turn. Behind the inner wall, Lio Venn watched with his name still written under refused.

**Edda**  
My teeth are singing. Water drum.

**Jori**  
The air tastes like iron. South rod.

**Pellin**  
My shadow moved first. I am stepping out.
Edda hummed into the drum until one raised finger ended the note. Jori grounded heat through the south rod. Pellin crossed the inner line and nobody called it failure.
At 00:08 the long local totality released its hold and light returned. The drill ended with a broken drum, a quarry crater and the students standing in their own bodies.
Mara entered the inner zone while the rifles stayed behind the barrier.

**Mara Tern**  
That blue line would have crossed the market.

**Suri**  
Yes.

**Mara Tern**  
You moved it because you knew it was coming.

**Suri**  
Because I was allowed to know.
Mara nodded once. It was not absolution; it was evidence accepted by the person who had demanded it.
Vale placed the copper band he had carried in his pocket inside the shattered drum.

**Vale**  
Permanent confinement has no defensible basis after tonight. I will sign the trial charter.

scenes.title: The Gate Opens Both Ways
paragraphs: *Northwall School, upper gate · 07:20, after sunrise*
The charter took six hours because nobody was allowed to turn relief into haste.

Vale signed away unilateral confinement authority. The council placed the restitution trust beyond the school budget; Mara named adaptive tools, damaged shops and treatment the old civic-loss clause had refused.
Twenty students chose the first thirty-day trial. Eight chose more practice. Four signed neither and kept the right to decide later.

Suri stood at the gate in a dark infirmary coat. Oren's bruised wrist rested in cloth. They had chosen Mara and a clinic engineer as their first escorts. Mara had agreed to the route, not to friendship.

**Vale**  
The east workshop remains a voluntary training hall. No white circles. No state called neutral.

**Oren**  
What will the monitors say?

**Vale**  
Tell us what you notice.
Suri turned the latch. MONSTERS split down the middle as the gate opened.
Some townspeople stepped back; others stayed. Tomas had surrendered his rifle and waited for the investigation. The charter did not require fear to become trust overnight.
Mara raised her damaged hand before Suri crossed.

**Mara Tern**  
I am not ready to tell you it is all right.

**Suri**  
It isn't.

**Mara Tern**  
The clinic needs a heat exchanger. The trust will pay you if the board approves your design. You work behind glass until I say otherwise.
Blue light filled Suri's eyes.

**Suri**  
I am relieved. It feels too much like fear. I can still hear your whole voice.
Mara opened her good hand toward the road.

**Mara Tern**  
Then walk while you can.
Suri crossed. Oren followed. Illuminara walked last, neither escort nor guard.
At the first bend Suri looked back. Vale had opened the other half of the gate so anyone could return by choice.
The painted word no longer formed a wall.

critic_line: On an eclipse night, Illuminara asks the question that lets frightened students and an injured town replace a suppression drill with a test every one of them can stop, and the last gate opens both ways.

shared_strengths: Strong premise, humane conflict resolution, dialogue-driven, and a satisfying MONSTERS gate image. Procedural negotiation is repetitive, characters speak in similar clipped, schematic registers, and the outcome feels tidy. Appeals to idea-driven readers but emotional depth is somewhat thin.

A vivid premise, morally serious conflict, and dialogue-driven tests turn consent and accountability into suspense rather than abstractions. Distinct wounds and refusals give the hopeful resolution weight. The procedural charter passages may feel slightly over-engineered and slow some readers, but the observatory failure, eclipse climax, and gate image should carry most through.
shared_reservations: Thirty-two white circles covered the floor. Above each, a monitor displayed one word: CALM.
Success would open only a thirty-day trial: daylight exits, student-chosen escorts, monitors chosen by injured residents and restrictions proved person by person.

translation_sl.title: NOČNA ŠOLA ZA POŠASTI
translation_sl.deck: Opolnoči bo mrk okrepil nehotene moči dvaintridesetih mladih, zaprtih za zidovi šole Northwall. Poškodovano mesto zunaj čaka z dušilnim orožjem; učenci se pripravljajo na pobeg. Illuminara mora dokazati, da je svobodo mogoče vaditi, ne da bi od preživelih zahtevali, naj zastavijo svoja telesa, ali od otrok, naj izginejo zaradi miru vseh drugih.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov skozi eno noč mrka: dve oboroženi vrsti pri vratih Northwalla; tišina, s katero šola skriva strah, dokler moč ne izbruhne; najodločnejša zavrnitev preživele; prostovoljna vaja, pri kateri prvi neuspeh razbije observatorij in dokaže, da je stara metoda nevarna; učenci in meščani, ki preoblikujejo preizkus z ločenimi pravicami veta; vaja med popolnim mrkom, v kateri Illuminara drži strukturo, mladi pa se uravnavajo sami; ter prostovoljno podpisana listina o postopni svobodi z odškodninami, neodvisnim nadzorom in prvimi vrati, odprtimi po izbiri.

scenes.title: Dve vrsti pri vratih
paragraphs: *Šola Northwall, zgornja vrata nad mestom Vela · 18.14, pet ur in šestinštirideset minut pred popolnim mrkom*
Učenci so na notranjo stran železnih vrat naslikali POŠASTI, še preden so meščani prišli z dušilnimi puškami. Zapis je bil s ceste obrnjen narobe. S šolskega dvorišča se je bral pravilno.

Dvaintrideset mladih je stalo za rešetkami v sivih vadbenih oblačilih. Na drugi strani ceste je tristo meščanov držalo svetilke, ščite in dolgo belo orožje, ki je nevarne darove za kratek čas omrtvičilo. Nekateri so prinesli hrano. Nekateri kamne.
Illuminara je pristala med obema vrstama brez bliska. Okoli njenih škornjev se je dvignil prah in se polegel.

Ravnatelj Vale je prišel po šolskih stopnicah z bakrenim nadzornim obročem okoli zapestja. Bil je visok, srebrnolas in je previdno ravnal z levo polovico telesa. Prvi nenadzorovani izbruh mu je zlomil kolk, ni pa ubil niti njegovega strahu niti občutka dolžnosti.

Za mestnimi ščiti je stala Mara Tern, mehaničarka, ki je pred tremi leti iz tržnega požara potegnila šest otrok. Koža na njeni desni roki je bila gladka in bleda. Zadnjih treh prstov ni mogla več skrčiti.
Dekle pri vratih je eno roko ovilo okoli rešetke. Drobne modre iskre so sledile njenemu utripu. Suri Dane je bila stara sedemnajst let in zaprta vse od tržnega požara.

**Suri**  
Če bodo prvi streljali oni, gremo skozi vzhodno steno.

**Vale**  
Če boste med ojačanjem mrka šli skozi katerokoli steno, bodo ljudje pod njo umrli.

**Suri**  
Potem odprite vrata pred polnočjo.

**Vale**  
Varnosti mesta ne bom zamenjal za obljubo, ki je ne more preveriti noben instrument.

Fant ob Suri je obe dlani pritiskal ob stegna. Vsakič, ko je kdo v množici zakričal, se je prod okoli njegovih čevljev dvignil za širino prsta in spet padel. Ime mu je bilo Oren Ilyas. Strah je v njegovi bližini spreminjal težnost; sram je povzročil, da je sprememba prišla brez opozorila.

**Mara Tern**  
Nocoj nihče ne bo ničesar odprl.
Surijine iskre so se okrepile.

**Mara Tern**  
Hočeš moj najodločnejši odgovor? Tukaj je. Ko je šola zadnjič rekla nadzorovano, sem se zbudila pod tržno ponjavo, medtem ko se mi je roka kuhala v rokavici. Ni bilo mrka. Ni bilo oborožene množice. Imeli ste učitelje in zidove. Vaš dokaz je propadel, še preden ste začeli.
Illuminara se je obrnila k njej, ne k puškam.

**Illuminara**  
Potem te nihče ne bo prosil, naj zaupaš besedi nadzorovano. Kaj bi veljalo kot dokaz in katero tveganje boš zavrnila, tudi če bodo učenci ostali zaprti?
Mara jo je preučevala, kakor da pričakuje ukaz, skrit v vprašanju.

**Mara Tern**  
Nobene vaje zunaj zidov. Nobenega preizkusa, ki ga ne morejo ustaviti ljudje v njem in ljudje pod njim. Nobenega razglašanja razbitega okna za uspeh samo zato, ker ni nihče umrl.

**Vale**  
Nobena komora ni poustvarila popolnega mrka. Opolnoči vsak model postane ugibanje.

**Suri**  
Njegov odgovor na negotovost pa je za vedno.
Luna je na zahodnem obzorju že odgriznila temen kos sonca. Šolski bakreni dušilni stolpi so začeli brneti.
Illuminara je pogledala Valejev obroč, Marino roko in Orenove otrple dlani.

**Illuminara**  
Ne bom vam odprla vrat in nikomur ne bom pomagala, da jih za vedno obdrži zaprta. Dajte mi eno uro, da izvem, čemu ta šola pravi nadzor. Potem lahko vsaka stran še vedno reče ne.
Suri je izpustila rešetko.

**Suri**  
Eno uro. Poslušaš tam, kjer nam pravijo, naj ne govorimo.

scenes.title: Učna ura z imenom Mir
paragraphs: *Šola Northwall, regulacijska dvorana · 18.42, pet ur in osemnajst minut pred popolnim mrkom*
Tla je prekrivalo dvaintrideset belih krogov. Nad vsakim je zaslon prikazoval eno besedo: MIR.
Vale je Suri in Orena postavil v ločena kroga. Bakrene niti so odvzele ostrino Surijinim iskram; Orenov prod se je polegel. Oba zaslona sta zasvetila zeleno.

**Vale**  
Polje zmanjša izražanje, dokler se učenec ne vrne na izhodiščno raven. Mirovanje pride pred nadzorovanim gibanjem.

**Suri**  
Vadimo, kako biti videti nenevarni.

**Vale**  
Videz nenevarnosti je tri leta preprečeval, da bi mesto napadlo.
Pozvonil je.

**Vale**  
Navedi nevtralno stanje.

**Suri**  
Nevtralno.
Čeljust se ji je zaklenila. Modra svetloba se je zbirala pod kožo njenega grla; zaslon je ostal zelen.

**Vale**  
Oren. Navedi nevtralno stanje.

**Oren**  
Nevtralno.
Kovinski stolček ob njem se je pogreznil v tla, ne da bi se ukrivil.
Illuminara se ni dotaknila nobenega učenca. Stopila je k bakrenemu stiku za Suri in pridržala dlan za širino prsta od njega.

**Illuminara**  
Ravnatelj, stopite sem. Z enim očesom glejte njen zaslon, z drugim ta stik.

**Vale**  
S kakšnim namenom?

**Illuminara**  
Da ugotoviva, ali zelena pomeni, da se nič ne dogaja, ali le, da nič ne prihaja iz nje.
Vala je prosila, naj polje zniža za tri odstotke. Zavrnil je. Suri je vprašala, ali bi nadaljevala pri isti nastavitvi. Tudi Suri je zavrnila.
Nekaj sekund sta v prostoru obstajala dva veljavna ne in noben postopek med njima.

**Suri**  
Povedala bom eno resnično stvar, če bo njegova roka deset sekund ostala stran od obroča.
Vale je umaknil roko. Suri jo je opazovala, ko se je spustila ob njegov bok.

**Suri**  
Strah me je.
Zaslon je ostal zelen. En vdih pozneje se je stik pod Illuminariino dlanjo segrel. Ob drugem je zažarel oranžno.

**Vale**  
Polje prenaša njen dvig v steno.
Oren je dvignil glavo.

**Oren**  
Najprej mi otrpnejo prsti. Morda dvajset sekund pred prodom. Pell je temu rekel pričakovalno dramatiziranje.

**Suri**  
Sluh se mi zoži. Če to povem, povečajo dušenje. Potem svetloba nima več kam oditi po malem.
Oranžna črta se je daljšala, čeprav je na Surijinem zaslonu še vedno pisalo MIR. Vale je pogledal od stika do stolčka, ugreznjenega v tla.

**Vale**  
Instrumenti beležijo tisto, kar uide, potem ko polje skrije opozorilo. Morda smo odložene signale šteli za preprečitev.
Stik je počil. Vale je izklopil dvorano. Surijina modra svetloba je udarila v zatemnjeni baker in izginila; Orenov stolček je skočil nazaj na svojo višino.
Nihče ni bil poškodovan. Beseda MIR je nad vsakim krogom ugasnila.

**Vale**  
Če je to res, me je metoda, s katero sem jih varoval, naučila, naj jih ne slišim.

**Illuminara**  
Imamo eno opažanje, ne razsodbe. Preizkusite ga — vendar naj ne plačujejo za vedno, da vam prihranijo preizkus.

scenes.title: Kaj pripada poškodovanim
paragraphs: *Šola Northwall, ambulanta za obiskovalce · 19.27, štiri ure in triintrideset minut pred popolnim mrkom*
Mara je vstopila v šolo z izpraznjeno puško, ki jo je nosil nekdo drug. Privolila je v opazovanje, ne v odpuščanje.
Suri je čakala ob pregledni mizi. Ko sta bili zadnjič tako blizu, je bila Suri stara štirinajst let, nezavestna in je žarela tako močno, da je streha tržnice postala prosojna, preden se je zrušila.
Nobena se ni prva opravičila.

**Mara Tern**  
Se me spomniš?

**Suri**  
Spomnim se tvojega rdečega plašča. Spomnim se, da sem mislila, da gori. Spomnim se, da sem se zbudila tukaj in so mi povedali, da so trije ljudje opečeni, ker me je zajela panika.
Mara je položila desno roko na mizo. Trije poškodovani prsti so ostali iztegnjeni.

**Mara Tern**  
Opekline je imelo enaintrideset ljudi. Trije so ostali v bolnišnici. Moja delavnica je bila zaprta osem mesecev. Šola je plačala zdravljenje kože, vse ostalo pa imenovala državljanska izguba.
Suri je pogoltnila. V mokrih kotičkih njenih oči so se pojavile modre iskre.
Vale se je dotaknil nadzornega obroča.

**Suri**  
Ne.

**Vale**  
Tvoj izhod narašča.

**Suri**  
Sluh se mi zožuje. Marin glas ima še vedno sredino. Strah me je, da me hoče imeti zaprto tukaj, dokler ne umrem. Ne bom je zažgala, ker je to rekla.

Iskre so stekle po Surijinih rokah in se ustavile na konicah prstov. Luči v prostoru so zatrepetale. Enkrat je vdihnila, pogledala Maro in izbrala prazno jekleno posodo ob mizi. Tanka modra pentlja je prečkala zrak in na njenem dnu stopila lužico v velikosti kovanca.
Valejev obroč je zabeležil sprostitev pod starim pragom incidenta.
Mara ni umaknila roke.

**Mara Tern**  
Prvič mi je kdo tukaj pokazal del pred požarom.

**Suri**  
Prvič so mi dovolili, da ga izrečem, ko je bil še majhen.
Mara se je obrnila k Illuminari.

**Mara Tern**  
Majhno v tej sobi ni majhno med popolnim mrkom.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Ojačanje ostaja neznano. Suri je dokazala nekaj ožjega: poimenovanje opozorila lahko ustvari čas za izbrano sprostitev. Končni preizkus mora pokazati, ali ta čas preživi mrk.

**Mara Tern**  
In če ga?

**Suri**  
Potem lahko odidem?

**Mara Tern**  
Potem ljudem dolguješ več kot to, da si manj nevarna.
Suri je pogledala poškodovano roko.

**Suri**  
Dolgujem popravo, ne obljube, da bom manj nevarna. Uporabite šolsko dotacijo za odškodninski sklad; poškodovani izberejo popravila in se jim nikoli ni treba srečati z nami.

**Mara Tern**  
Moja delavnica je izgubila pogodbe, ker nisem mogla več skleniti roke okoli ključa. V sklad vključite plačano delo in prilagojena orodja, preden bo kdo temu rekel sprava.
Illuminara je oba pogoja zapisala na stenski zaslon ambulante. Ob njiju ni bilo vpisano odpuščanje.

scenes.title: Prvi pošteni neuspeh
paragraphs: *Šola Northwall, stari observatorij · 21.06, dve uri in štiriinpetdeset minut pred popolnim mrkom*

Observatorij ni imel stene, obrnjene proti mestu. Njegov odprti lok je namesto tega gledal proti opuščenemu kamnolomu, vrezanemu v goro. Vale ga je odobril, ker se je vsaka sproščena sila lahko usmerila v prazno skalo. Mara ga je odobrila, ker je vaja ostala znotraj šolskih meja.

Suri in Oren sta vstopila po lastni izbiri. Vsak bi lahko odšel skozi vrata brez ključavnice. Mara je držala zunanje stikalo za prekinitev. Vale je upravljal šolsko polje. Suri je držala rdečo vrvico, ki bi prekinila napajanje njenega kroga. Oren je držal drugo.
Illuminara je stala med krogoma in nosilnim lokom observatorija. Če bi kamen počil, bi ga lahko zadržala. Učencema ni mogla odvzeti moči, niti ne bi odločala, kdaj njun strah postane nesprejemljiv.
Delni mrk se je poglobil. Surijina modra svetloba se je pri istem čustvenem signalu podvojila. Orenovo polje je potegnilo prah v lebdeč obroč.

**Suri**  
Sluh se mi zožuje. Oren zveni daleč stran. Želim vzhodno posodo.

**Oren**  
Prsti so mrzli. Petnajst sekund. Želim dno kamnoloma.
Vale je okleval nad krmilom.

**Vale**  
Izhodne vrednosti presegajo omejitev dvorane.

**Suri**  
Ta omejitev je bila zgrajena za tišino.
Mara je držala roko nad stikalom za prekinitev.

**Mara Tern**  
Nadaljujta en korak. Odločitev je moja.

Suri je usmerila tanek lok v vzhodno posodo. Oren je za malenkost zmanjšal težnost dna kamnoloma, zato se je lok razširil čez dvigajoči se prah, namesto da bi udaril v skalo. Za tri sekunde je modra svetloba postala tiha plošča, viseča zunaj loka.

Illuminara je občutila veselje, še preden ga je previdnost lahko poimenovala. Mlada človeka sta iz prav tistih signalov, ki jih je šola prepovedala, ustvarila majhno umetno zarjo. Enkrat se je zasmejala in Suri jo je slišala.

**Suri**  
Je bilo to v postopku?

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Obdrži ga, če pomaga.
Tedaj je Oren pogledal proti vratom. Množica je začela skandirati. Njegovi prsti so pobeleli.

**Oren**  
Pet sekund. Prehitro.
Lebdeči prah se je sesedel v gosto črno vozlišče. Surijina svetloba se je ukrivila proti njemu namesto proti posodi.

**Vale**  
Prekinitev.
Vale je povečal dušilno polje. Nenaden pritisk je izbrisal preostanek Orenovega opozorila in Surijin lok porinil vstran. Potegnila je svojo rdečo vrvico, toda polje je že zvarilo njen stik.
Mara je udarila po zunanji prekinitvi. Napajanje loka je ugasnilo. Kamen nad Illuminari se je razklal.

Z obema rokama je prevzela njegovo težo, medtem ko je Orenovo težnostno vozlišče vleklo razbite instrumente po tleh. Suri se je vrgla k njemu, ne da bi ga zadržala, temveč da bi svoj glas postavila v njegov zožujoči se svet.

**Suri**  
Oren. Moj glas ima sredino. Tvoja leva roka je topla. Dno kamnoloma, ne množica.

**Oren**  
Ne najdem smeri navzdol.

**Suri**  
Uporabi mene. Stojim. Navzdol je tam, kjer so moja stopala.
Oren je pogledal njene škornje. Črno vozlišče se je odprlo. Instrumenti so padli. Suri je preostalo svetlobo poslala v prazni kamnolom, kjer je čez trideset metrov skale zarisala modro črto.
Observatorijski lok se je v Illuminariinih rokah počasi spuščal. Držala ga je, dokler niso vsi prestopili praga, nato pa razbiti kamen položila na dvorišče.
Preizkus je propadel. Ena merilna naprava je bila uničena, strehe observatorija ni bilo več, Orenovo desno zapestje pa je bilo podpluto tam, kjer je težnost njegov nadzorni obroč prepognila ob roko.
Mara je pregledala zvarjeno rdeče stikalo.

**Mara Tern**  
Dušenje je opozorilo spremenilo v nesrečo.
Vale je snel bakreni obroč.

**Vale**  
Moj poseg jo je.

**Suri**  
Potem ne zahtevajte, da opolnoči zaupamo vaši roki.
Vale je pogledal razbiti observatorij in se ni zagovarjal.

**Vale**  
Ne bom. Zasnovajte sistem, v katerem je moj strah opozorilo, ne ukaz.

scenes.title: Preizkus, ki so ga lahko ustavili vsi
paragraphs: *Šola Northwall, montažna delavnica · 22.02, ena ura in oseminpetdeset minut pred popolnim mrkom*
Končno vajo so preoblikovali okoli neuspeha, ne okoli dostojanstva kogarkoli.

Oren je narisal tri območja: učenec je poimenoval opozorilo in izbral sprostitev; partner je ponovil samo tisto, kar je bilo mogoče opazovati; zunanji opazovalci so lahko ustavili napredovanje, niso pa mogli sprožiti dušenja.

Suri je zvarjeni kabel predelala v mehanski zaklop. Mara je njegov ročaj preizkusila s poškodovano roko. Vale je odprl preliv, ki bi spustil nevezani bazalt v prazen kanal, kadar bi toplota ali težnost presegla mejo.
Illuminara je pogledala od Marinega stikala za prekinitev do rdečih vrvic učencev.

**Illuminara**  
Če je osebo znotraj preveč strah, da bi izrekla stop, kdo ga sme izreči? In ali sme ta roka znova zagnati dušenje?

**Mara Tern**  
Zunanji opazovalci smejo ustaviti napredovanje. Nihče zunaj ne sme zagnati dušenja.

**Suri**  
In nocojšnja ustavitev ne razveljavi naše pravice do popravljenega preizkusa.

**Vale**  
Ob popolnem mrku lahko opozorilno okno izgine. Potem ne izvemo nič drugega kot to, da sem imel prav, ko sem vrata pustil zaprta.

**Oren**  
Potem ustavimo. Jutri se še vedno motite glede za vedno.
Vale je sprejel odgovor, ne da bi branil tri izgubljena leta.

Uspeh bi odprl le tridesetdnevni poskus: izhode pri dnevni svetlobi, spremljevalce po izbiri učencev, nadzornike po izbiri poškodovanih prebivalcev in omejitve, dokazane za vsakega posameznika. Neuspeh je ohranil pravico do popravljenega preizkusa.

**Mara Tern**  
Nevaren ni priimek. Tudi poškodovan ne. Sklad najprej plača popravila in nihče si z njim ne kupi odpuščanja.

**Vale**  
Vsak sme ostati na usposabljanju, ne da bi se odrekel pravici, da pozneje odide.

**Illuminara**  
Odnesite to ljudem, ki ga še vedno lahko zavrnejo.
Pri spodnjih vratih je Mara na kamnito pregrado položila šolske zapise o zadušenih opozorilih. Tomas Ren, čigar hči je enajst tednov preživela na oddelku za opekline, je prebral prvega.

**Tomas Ren**  
Šola je skrivala ta opozorila, naš svet pa je plačal puške. Zdaj ista šola mojo hčer prosi, naj stoji pod njenim poskusom.

**Mara Tern**  
Stoji, kjer sama izbere. Jaz držim ročico za ustavitev, poškodovani prebivalci izberejo nadzornike, pogodba za puške pa financira prve odškodninske zahtevke.
Tomas je prebral naslednje opozorilo.

**Tomas Ren**  
Ena vaja. Puške spuščene, ne odstranjene. Gledam ročico, ne zaupam šoli.
Zgoraj je Suri iste štiri vrstice prebrala spalnicam. Podpisalo se je osemindvajset učencev. Lio Venn, čigar koža je pod stresom postala steklena, svojega imena ni dodal.

**Lio Venn**  
Če se pridružim, bodo moje telo imenovali dokaz, ne glede na to, ali privolim.

**Suri**  
Potem se ne pridruži. Boš ostal za notranjim zidom, dokler se vaja ne konča?

**Lio Venn**  
Če moja zavrnitev ostane v načrtu.
Suri jo je zapisala s črnilom. Trije drugi so pod njegovo dodali svoje zavrnitve.
Mara se je vrnila z omejenim soglasjem mesta; Suri z osemindvajsetimi podpisi in štirimi poimenskimi ne. Vale je prebral vsako vrstico.

**Vale**  
Nadaljujte.

scenes.title: Popolni mrk
paragraphs: *Šola Northwall, vadbišče ob kamnolomu · 23.56, štiri minute pred popolnim mrkom*
Luna je izbrisala zadnji beli rob sonca. V dnevni temi so se prižgale Veline svetilke.

Šest učencev je stalo v notranjem območju. Vale ni nosil nadzornega obroča. Mara je držala zunanji zaklop; množica je čakala za spodnjo pregrado. Illuminara je stala pod popravljenim ogrodjem, s prostima rokama.
Ob popolnem mrku se je Surijina modra svetloba dvignila okoli njenih kolen. Orenova težnost je privzdignila obroč prodnikov. Izhodna moč polja je naraščala skoraj trikrat hitreje kot v observatoriju.

**Suri**  
Sluh se mi zožuje. Strah me je množice in še bolj tega, da se vrnem gor. Vzhodna posoda.

**Oren**  
Leva roka je topla. Dno kamnoloma.

Svetloba se je razlila čez prodnike in vsakega spremenila v modro zvezdo. Nosilno ogrodje se je premaknilo. Illuminara je prestregla le silo, ki bi kovino vrgla proti opazovalcem; polji učencev sta ostali njuni.
Moški pri pregradi je dvignil dušilno puško.

**Tomas Ren**  
Modra črta prečka oznako!

**Mara Tern**  
Znotraj posode je. Spusti jo.
Ustrelil je. Beli sunek je zadel pregrado, ne učencev, toda Oren ga je videl. Njegovo opozorilno okno se je sesulo.

**Oren**  
Vse je mrzlo.
Mara je segla po zaklopu. Vale prav tako, nato pa se je ustavil.

**Vale**  
Oren, strah me je. Ne ukazujem miru. Kaj opažaš?
Prodniki so pospešili. Surijin glas se je enakomerno prebijal skozi temo.

**Suri**  
Moja stopala so spodaj. Illuminara drži ogrodje. Mara ni zaprla zaklopa. Puška je na tleh.
Tomas se je odmaknil od nje z obema rokama na vidnem mestu.

**Tomas Ren**  
Moja hči je bila pod tržnim steklom. Mislil sem, da črta prihaja nad nas.

**Mara Tern**  
Tvoj strah pojasni strel. Ne opraviči ga. Stopi nazaj.
Ubogal je. Mara je ročico pustila odprto.

**Mara Tern**  
Tvoja odločitev, Oren. Ustavitev ali en korak.

**Oren**  
En korak. Odprite tla.
Vale je sprostil preliv. Oren je padajoči bazalt potegnil v črno kroglo velikosti pesti, nato pa jo spustil v prazni kamnolom. Gora je zadonela. Suri je za njo po kanalu poslala svojo svetlobo.
Ogrodje se je nehalo premikati. Illuminara ga je izpustila; popravljene opore so vzdržale.
Še trije učenci so po vrsti vstopili. Za notranjim zidom je Lio Venn gledal, njegovo ime pa je še vedno stalo pod zapisom »zavrnil«.

**Edda**  
Zobje mi pojejo. Vodni boben.

**Jori**  
Zrak ima okus po železu. Južna palica.

**Pellin**  
Moja senca se je premaknila prva. Stopam ven.
Edda je brundala v boben, dokler en dvignjen prst ni končal tona. Jori je toploto ozemljil skozi južno palico. Pellin je prestopil notranjo črto in nihče tega ni imenoval neuspeh.
Ob 00.08 je dolgi krajevni popolni mrk popustil in svetloba se je vrnila. Vaja se je končala z razbitim bobnom, kraterjem v kamnolomu in učenci, ki so stali v lastnih telesih.
Mara je vstopila v notranje območje, medtem ko so puške ostale za pregrado.

**Mara Tern**  
Ta modra črta bi prečkala tržnico.

**Suri**  
Da.

**Mara Tern**  
Premaknila si jo, ker si vedela, da prihaja.

**Suri**  
Ker mi je bilo dovoljeno vedeti.
Mara je enkrat prikimala. To ni bila odveza; oseba, ki je zahtevala dokaz, ga je sprejela.
Vale je bakreni obroč, ki ga je nosil v žepu, položil v razbiti boben.

**Vale**  
Po nocojšnjem več ni mogoče zagovarjati trajnega zaprtja. Podpisal bom listino o poskusnem obdobju.

scenes.title: Vrata se odprejo v obe smeri
paragraphs: *Šola Northwall, zgornja vrata · 07.20, po sončnem vzhodu*
Listino so sestavljali šest ur, ker nihče ni smel olajšanja spremeniti v naglico.

Vale se je s podpisom odrekel enostranski oblasti zapiranja. Svet je odškodninski sklad postavil zunaj šolskega proračuna; Mara je navedla prilagojena orodja, poškodovane delavnice in zdravljenje, ki ga je stara določba o državljanski izgubi zavrnila.
Dvajset učencev je izbralo prvo tridesetdnevno poskusno obdobje. Osem jih je izbralo več vaje. Štirje niso podpisali ničesar in so obdržali pravico, da se odločijo pozneje.

Suri je stala pri vratih v temnem ambulantnem plašču. Orenovo podpluto zapestje je počivalo v tkanini. Za prva spremljevalca sta izbrala Maro in kliničnega inženirja. Mara je privolila v pot, ne v prijateljstvo.

**Vale**  
Vzhodna delavnica ostane prostovoljna vadbena dvorana. Brez belih krogov. Brez stanja z imenom nevtralno.

**Oren**  
Kaj bodo rekli zasloni?

**Vale**  
Povejte nam, kaj opažate.
Suri je obrnila zapah. Beseda POŠASTI se je razcepila po sredini, ko so se vrata odprla.
Nekateri meščani so stopili nazaj; drugi so ostali. Tomas je predal puško in čakal na preiskavo. Listina ni zahtevala, da se strah čez noč spremeni v zaupanje.
Mara je dvignila poškodovano roko, preden je Suri prestopila.

**Mara Tern**  
Nisem ti še pripravljena reči, da je vse v redu.

**Suri**  
Ni.

**Mara Tern**  
Klinika potrebuje izmenjevalnik toplote. Sklad ti bo plačal, če uprava odobri tvojo zasnovo. Delaš za steklom, dokler ne rečem drugače.
Modra svetloba je napolnila Surijine oči.

**Suri**  
Odleglo mi je. Občutek je preveč podoben strahu. Še vedno slišim ves tvoj glas.
Mara je razprla zdravo dlan proti cesti.

**Mara Tern**  
Potem hodi, dokler lahko.
Suri je prestopila. Oren ji je sledil. Illuminara je hodila zadnja, ne kot spremljevalka ne kot stražarka.
Pri prvem ovinku se je Suri ozrla. Vale je odprl še drugo polovico vrat, da se je lahko vsak vrnil po lastni izbiri.
Naslikana beseda ni več tvorila zidu.

translation_sl.critic_line: Na noč mrka Illuminara postavi vprašanje, ki prestrašenim učencem in poškodovanemu mestu omogoči, da vajo dušenja zamenjajo s preizkusom, ki ga lahko ustavi vsak izmed njih, zadnja vrata pa se odprejo v obe smeri.
